title: Long Vowels: Final-e and Vowel Teams
description: Meet final-e and six vowel teams; read and match words; sort words by long vowel sound; and read short decodable sentences.
learningFocus: Read one-syllable words with final-e and the vowel teams ai, ay, ee, ea, oa, and ow, and use the long vowel sound to read short sentences.
adultGuidance: Say the vowel name, not the letter names of the team: ai says A, not a-i. If your child is stuck on a word, cover the team or the silent e with a finger, read the rest of the word, then add the long sound. Page 1 pairs are cap/cape, kit/kite, hop/hope, tub/tube; Page 2 matches cake, bike, rope, home, tube, kite; Page 3 teams are ai rain, ay play, ee bee, ea sea, oa boat, ow snow; Page 4 sorts rain, sail, play, day under Long A, bee, tree, sea, bean under Long E, and boat, soap, snow, blow under Long O; Page 5 sentences are the cat and the bee, the boat on the lake, playing in the rain, and the kite in the tree.
keywords: vowel teams ai ay ee ea oa ow
